> [!NOTE]
> Thank you for proposing an enhancement! DeskPilot is a local-first, privacy-respecting Windows desktop command center. Feature proposals are reviewed for alignment with core architectural guarantees (offline operation, zero telemetry, strictly bounded privileges, and native Windows performance). Submitting a proposal does not guarantee implementation or inclusion.

<!-- Is your feature request related to a specific workflow friction or missing capability? Please describe clearly. -->

### Proposed Feature
<!-- A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing. -->

### Expected User Benefit
<!-- Why should this feature be added? How does it improve the user experience or system management? -->

### Example Use Case
<!-- Describe a concrete scenario: "As a developer using Windows 11 with multiple monitors, I want to..." -->

### Suggested Behavior & User Interface
<!-- How would this look or behave in DeskPilot? (e.g., changes to Home, Apps catalog, Quick Launcher, or Settings) -->

### Potential Compatibility, Privacy, or Security Considerations
<!-- Does this require additional OS permissions? Does it affect offline guarantees or write local state? -->

### Alternatives Considered
<!-- Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered. -->
